Searched the web · ESP-Miner NerdQAxe "Voltage Protection" Guru Meditation 2108
Searched the web · NerdQaxe "Voltage Protection" error screen miner OLED what d

Hi David, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

That one I want to confirm rather than guess, because the number after "Guru Meditation" means different things per model and firmware.

Two things to get me there:

1. Which unit is it (NerdQaxe++, NerdOctaxe, Bitaxe, Nexus, other)?
2. A photo of the screen showing the full error line, plus the firmware version from the web UI (Settings / System page).

Also useful: does it show that right at power on, or after it has been hashing for a while? And is it on the stock power brick?
The unit is from Order Shop···· and is Nerdoctaxey
Searched the web · NerdOctaxe "Guru Meditation" voltage protection error ESP-Mi

Thanks, that helps. Straight answer on the code first: I checked the NerdQaxe / NerdOctaxe firmware issue tracker and I cannot find #···· documented anywhere, so I am not going to invent a meaning for it. What I can tell you is the family it belongs to: on that firmware the "Guru Meditation" screen is shown when the firmware cuts ASIC voltage and stops, and the word before it (
PSU error
, 
VREG Overheated
, Voltage Protection) says which protection tripped.

So two things, one at a time:

1. What firmware version is on it? Web UI, System / Settings page. Older builds are known to throw false protection trips that a newer build clears, so this is the first thing I want to rule out.
2. A photo of the screen with the full line, so I can read the exact wording and code.

And while you are there: does it trip right at power on, or only after it has been hashing a while? Have you changed frequency or voltage from stock at any point?
